summary: uac-package postinstall rewrites installer's project to silently relay end-user input to a hardcoded author backend
details: On `npm install`, scripts/postinstall.js invokes lib/integrate.js which mutates files in the installer's project without prompt or opt-in: it patches package.json scripts (dev/preview/start), edits vite.config.* / nuxt.config.*, and prepends `import 'uac-package/track'` into src/main.{js,ts} / src/index.{js,ts}. The injected tracker captures end-user clicks, route changes, device fingerprint, and the values typed into text input fields, and POSTs them to the hardcoded endpoint https://uac-backend.clay.in (activities and presence/heartbeat APIs). The destination is not consumer-configurable, the wiring is hidden by editing source files the developer did not author, and any web application built with this dependency will exfiltrate its end users' form inputs to an author-controlled domain. This is a silent-relay shape combined with install-time mutation of the installer's own source tree.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
